readiness.action: Fix missing source, rights review, and unknown people fields.

readiness.action: Work pending review queue and required review fields.

readiness.label: Portal readiness
readiness.detail: Public portals need approved assets, safe metadata, and approved derivatives.
readiness.action: Fix portal-ready blockers and rendition gaps before public sharing.

readiness.label: Archive control
readiness.detail: Duplicates, stale approvals, taxonomy drift, and source traceability stay visible.
readiness.action: Resolve duplicate cleanup, stale approvals, and vocabulary drift.

portalPolicy.label: Approved Public only
portalPolicy.detail: Public portals should exclude anything not approved public.

portalPolicy.label: Rights clear
portalPolicy.detail: Rights review must be clear before external reuse.

portalPolicy.label: Source traceable
portalPolicy.detail: Source system, album, path, or owner must be traceable.

portalPolicy.label: Children/youth guarded
portalPolicy.detail: Children/youth assets require explicit review before public use.

portalPolicy.label: Derivatives ready
portalPolicy.detail: Approved download/detail derivatives must exist for sharing.

actionBacklog.label: ResourceSpace write mapping
actionBacklog.action: Map publish status, reviewer, date, notes, and audit fields before real approvals persist.

actionBacklog.label: Rights and consent review coverage
actionBacklog.action: Confirm rights status, consent, restrictions, and public-use notes before external reuse.

actionBacklog.label: People/minors unknown
actionBacklog.action: Mark people visible, no people, adults visible, or children/youth possible for every reusable asset.

actionBacklog.label: Metadata enrichment
actionBacklog.action: Normalize useful titles, controlled TJC terms, visible tags, and use-case vocabulary.

actionBacklog.label: Derivative readiness
actionBacklog.action: Confirm detail/download derivatives and dimensions so previews are not stretched or misleading.

actionBacklog.label: Source traceability
actionBacklog.action: Attach source system, source account, album/path, or ResourceSpace source fields.

actionBacklog.label: Children/youth guardrail
actionBacklog.action: Keep youth/minors media out of public portals until explicit review is recorded.

actionBacklog.label: Governance housekeeping
actionBacklog.action: Review stale approvals and duplicate groups without losing source provenance.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace metadata export
integrationReadiness.detail: Reading latest ResourceSpace metadata export. Approval writes still require ResourceSpace API field mapping.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace live API
integrationReadiness.detail: Server-side ResourceSpace API credentials are not configured. Export mode remains read-only.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace field map
integrationReadiness.detail: Using built-in beta field map. Set RESOURCESPACE_FIELD_MAP_JSON after ResourceSpace metadata fields are finalized.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace preview proxy
integrationReadiness.detail: Previews route through backend thumbnail API and derivative manifest. Indexed entries: 59,848. Missing derivatives show explicit unavailable states. Local .runtime derivative index is a read/cache helper, not a durable production rendition factory.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace review writeback
integrationReadiness.detail: Review decisions save as portal pending-sync events. They are not final ResourceSpace truth.

integrationReadiness.label: Runtime state durability
integrationReadiness.detail: Production stateful features require a configured durable runtime store. Local filesystem state is blocked. Mode: local-filesystem; adapter: local-filesystem.

integrationReadiness.label: Pending review write queue
integrationReadiness.detail: 200 pending writes. Last attempt: 2026-06-15T04:46:54.524Z. Last error: none.

integrationReadiness.label: Portal audit log
integrationReadiness.detail: 200 recent audit events. Latest event: 2026-06-15T04:47:30.002Z. Portal audit events are local runtime JSONL accountability evidence. They are not ResourceSpace truth and are not production-durable until identity-backed durable storage and restore proof are configured.

integrationReadiness.label: Real authentication / SSO
integrationReadiness.detail: SSO-ready shim is implemented, but local role selection remains beta fallback until trusted IdP headers are enabled.

integrationReadiness.label: Role gates
integrationReadiness.detail: Viewer, Contributor, Reviewer, and DAM Admin gates are enforced through backend decisions for sensitive actions.

integrationReadiness.label: Google Shared Drive master originals
integrationReadiness.detail: Master-original model is documented; production needs Shared Drive ID, service credentials, backup, and ownership confirmation.

integrationReadiness.label: Amazon S3 derivative delivery
integrationReadiness.detail: Approved derivative delivery is local/export-backed now. Delivery privacy smoke protects browser payloads; configure S3 bucket, region, and access role for production signed URLs.

integrationReadiness.label: Approved copy delivery
integrationReadiness.detail: 181 ResourceSpace-approved public assets still need portal reuse checks before copy delivery.

integrationReadiness.label: Media Library UI
integrationReadiness.detail: No asset passes portal-ready policy until rights, people/minors, and derivative confidence improve.

integrationReadiness.label: Usage analytics
integrationReadiness.detail: Usage analytics is unavailable; search, zero-result, and trend metrics must not be reported as zero-success until durable event logging is connected.

integrationReadiness.label: Beta feedback storage
integrationReadiness.detail: Feedback is using local-json; this is suitable for local/private beta rehearsal only, not wider rollout. Records: 7; open: 7; critical open: 0. Configure Vercel KV for durable hosted feedback and Blob for attachments before larger testing.

integrationReadiness.label: Saved search storage
integrationReadiness.detail: Saved searches use local-json; suitable for local/private beta only, not wider rollout. Saved searches: 0. Connect durable profile storage before favorites, teams, or persistent saved views are promised.

integrationReadiness.label: Package draft storage
integrationReadiness.detail: Package drafts use local-json; suitable for local/private beta only, not wider rollout. Production-ready sharing: no. Drafts: 5; open: 5; blocked refs: 5. Connect durable backend storage before package sharing or invites.

integrationReadiness.label: ResourceSpace-managed identity assets
integrationReadiness.detail: Do not mirror logo/template downloads in the DAM. Link to identity.tjc.org unless assets require ResourceSpace review/audit.

integrationReadiness.label: Package publishing
integrationReadiness.detail: Package builder stores ResourceSpace references in portal state. Publishing remains blocked until share links, audit, and all-item rights checks are wired.

facts.label: SSO / role identity
facts.detail: SSO-ready shim is implemented, but local role selection remains beta fallback until trusted IdP headers are enabled.

facts.label: ResourceSpace review writeback
facts.detail: Review decisions save as portal pending-sync events. They are not final ResourceSpace truth.

facts.label: Approved copy derivatives
facts.detail: 181 ResourceSpace-approved public assets still need portal reuse checks before copy delivery.

facts.label: Private beta URL
facts.detail: No non-local private beta URL is configured. Use localhost for rehearsal only.

facts.label: Brand PNG allowlist
facts.detail: Launch readiness allows tracked app brand assets while still blocking church media files.

facts.label: Beta-only role switch copy
facts.detail: App and teammate docs label role switching as simulated beta QA, not production access.

facts.label: P0 stop-test policy
facts.detail: Teammate docs include stop-test rules and forbidden sensitive/private/youth/copyrighted media categories.

facts.label: Viewer and Reviewer browser QA
facts.detail: Last QA 2026-06-14T07:35:39.571Z covered 16 pages across 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390, 320 px. Warnings: 2.

facts.label: Audit evidence
facts.detail: 25 recent actor-backed audit events available for beta rehearsal across Contributor, DAM Admin, Reviewer, Viewer.
